sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.version_commit: W3C Recommendation published 2024-12-12; dated stable edition, not the mutable latest-version alias.
sources.locator: SC 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded), Level A; SC 1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded), Level AA.
observed_operations: Located and read the normative text and conformance levels for SC 1.2.3 and SC 1.2.5.
sources.evidence_note: SC 1.2.3 at Level A permits an audio description or a time-based media alternative for prerecorded synchronized video; SC 1.2.5 at Level AA requires audio description.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 1.2.5: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
sources.version_commit: WAI informative Understanding document as served 2026-10-09; mutable supporting guidance, no fixed revision identifier exposed in the inspected page.
sources.locator: Intent/note for SC 1.2.5 on existing audio already conveying important video information; SC 1.2.3 versus SC 1.2.5 discussion; advisory technique H96.
observed_operations: Located and read the note that no additional description is necessary when existing audio conveys all important video information.
Read the explanatory distinction between the Level A alternative and the Level AA audio-description requirement.
sources.evidence_note: WAI explains that if all important video information is already conveyed in audio, no additional description is necessary; otherwise the Level A media-alternative option does not replace the Level AA requirement. The page presents the track element as an advisory technique.

sources.title: HTML Standard — The track element
sources.version_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard as served 2026-10-09; mutable standard, no fixed revision identifier exposed by the inspected page.
sources.locator: Text-track kind definitions; descriptions kind and its stated use for audio synthesis when video is obscured, unavailable or unusable.
observed_operations: Located and read the descriptions kind definition.
sources.evidence_note: The standard defines descriptions as textual descriptions intended for synthesis as audio; this semantic definition does not prove end-to-end support in a selected browser/player/assistive-technology stack.
